reasons: Cited text supports compliance: Section 9.4 grants Customer an unconditional without-cause termination right over the Agreement or any Order Form, with only accrued Fees owed and a refund of prepaid Fees for the post-termination period — matching the preferred position's pro-rata refund and no-penalty requirement.
Section 29.4 fixes the notice period at thirty days, exactly the preferred 30-day notice.

Cited paragraphs show a three-year term (8.1) with no Vendor termination-for-convenience right, consistent with the preferred position that Vendor has no convenience right during a committed term; the rationale's treatment of 7.7 late-payment liquidated damages as outside this rule is reasonable.

No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; the deterministic check for a Customer convenience right passes and the paragraphs are returned unmodified.
